en: Linux: Fixed sandboxed Bash commands failing with `bwrap: Can't create file` when the working directory was below an `allowRead` folder inside a `denyRead`, such as under a symlinked home directory
zh: Linux：修复了当工作目录位于 `denyRead` 内某个 `allowRead` 文件夹之下（例如符号链接的主目录下）时，沙箱化 Bash 命令因 `bwrap: Can't create file` 失败的问题
